rows.grounds: nominal form denoting withdrawal or absorption
past passive participle indicating what is taught
compound referring to the lords of that group or function
demonstrative pronoun referring to the figures in view

items.question: What identity is assigned to these figures in relation to dissolution?
premises: Dissolution is explicitly declared in this statement.
These figures are identified as their lords.
The particle marks a contrastive specification of their role.
items.inference: These figures are declared to be the lords associated with dissolution.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation between saṃhāraḥ and tatpatayas is not fully explicit.
items.plain_english: Dissolution is declared, but these are their lords.
